title: Process & shell execution
description: Inventory of external process / shell execution: Send Event and Perform AppleScript (Step_ID-gated, locale-independent) plus MBS Shell / RunTask / Process calls (resolved via calls_pluginfunction). Shows where the solution hands control to the operating system.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).

params.name: mechanism
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a mechanism (Send Event / AppleScript / MBS Shell / MBS RunTask / MBS Process). 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows returned by the detail list.
